rehearsal.sourceIsolationProof: mutating restored aggregate version to 99 left source aggregate version at 1

falsificationControls: restore target must differ from source
restore target names containing prod or production are rejected
backup artifact must exist and be non-empty
restored canonical digest must exactly equal source digest
restored canonical state must independently rebuild the expected material order summary
mutation of restored state must not mutate source canonical state

closure.basis: Automated exact-head PostgreSQL backup creation and isolated restore rehearsal proves canonical-state equivalence, deterministic material rebuild, and source isolation without targeting a live production store. This satisfies the RC2-DUR-001 closure condition while preserving the prohibition on destructive production restore rehearsal.

notClaimed: closure of RC2-AUTH-001 or any unrelated readiness finding
